outcomes: The program is designed to provide students with the necessary skills for effective tutoring. Through the program, participants will be able to differentiate between the roles and responsibilities of tutors and tutees, encouraging a collaborative and accountable learning environment. Additionally, students will gain proficiency in tutoring strategies to cater to individual learning needs. They will also maintain academic and ethical standards while improving techniques for supporting tutees with written assignments, promoting critical thinking and academic success.
